name: Hamilton PSD/4 dual syringe pump
roles: Pump A — All reagents are compatible and soluble in EtOH/pH 9 buffer; pre-mixed in a single degassed feed solution to minimize pump count and ensure O2 exclusion. Solution prepared offline in pre-degassed EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) and loaded into a gas-tight syringe or sealed reservoir.

name: Bronkhorst FLEXI-FLOW Compact oxygen MFC
roles: MFC B — Oxygen is introduced as a gas stream via the Bronkhorst O2 MFC and mixed into the liquid outlet of Stage 1 at a T-junction. Segmented gas-liquid (Taylor) flow enhances O2 mass transfer in the PFA coil.
